_comment: One checklist for every platform (windows, linux, macos). box/pass.ps1 and box/pass.sh record one JSON line per step id; lib/verdict.mjs applies these expectations. ${expectVersion}/${baselineVersion} come from run.mjs. envLimited = failure explained by a documented environment limit (no systemd in the Linux container); an envLimited rule with `drivers` applies only under those drivers, so the host driver on a real VM never excuses a missing service.

U2.title: Upgrade a core-only (no Node) install along the apra-fleet update path
U2._comment: Since v0.4.3 a no-Node user can only hold a core-only install (--workflows none); the default install refuses without Node. This pass upgrades that user: the default installer still refuses and leaves the baseline running, and the update argv (install-config workflowsMode) upgrades core-only without Node.

C.title: Git credential helpers across an upgrade (baseline legacy global helper -> candidate per-member helpers)
C._comment: C01-C06 run in box/pass.ps1 / box/pass.sh; every scenario step runs in box/pass-c.mjs (one implementation for both dialects). CP/CS/CQ/CR/CW/CX run the baseline and then the candidate server by hand on an overridden HOME (and USERPROFILE on Windows); CN uses the real home, the installer and install --force (the docker driver gives the pass C box user the home /home/fi o'brien, so there CN runs a real user whose home has an apostrophe and a space). Step 11 compares with the baseline (step 16): a legacy entry the upgrade does not touch must behave as before. PAT tokens are dummy strings and members have no repo, so provision never reaches the network.
